profiles.coordinateConvention: Local orthographic detail datum at nominal corner; x right and y up. Axes retained separately because the drawing supplies ordinate callouts, not an explicit paired point table.

profiles.coordinateConvention: Local top-left datum shown in detail M; x right and y up; negative y ordinates descend from the datum.
profiles.note: Unpaired ordinate callouts, not a closed polygon.

profiles.coordinateConvention: Local section datum at outer front-side edge; x inward and y negative through device thickness. Top and bottom edges supply different x samples.
profiles.note: These are axis callouts for two edge curves; do not zip x/y or treat them as a complete paired contour.

reviewScope: Display/body/camera plus named apertures, connector clearance, keepout cones, button/sensor dimensions and three local contour ordinate sets. Magnetic locations and remaining detail contours are still incomplete. Magnet page now includes L1-L12 positions/polarities, compass/Hall-sensor locations and clearance, and five magnetic exclusion regions; BV/O/CG arrays now have paired positions and the complete polarity table is normalized. PM individual y centers remain unlocated; their printed group reference ordinates are retained.

magnetDetail.coordinateConvention: Magnet detail front view: origin at center smart-connector pin, x right, y up. This origin differs from the body-centred display coordinate system.

profiles.coordinateConvention: Local section datum at outer front-side edge; x inward and y negative through device thickness. Top and bottom edges supply different x samples.

reviewScope: Display/body/camera plus named apertures, connector clearance, keepout cones, button/sensor dimensions and three local contour ordinate sets. All BV/O/OR/CG positions and polarity entries are normalized. Individual PM y locations remain partial; group reference coordinates are retained.

profiles.coordinateConvention: Local orthographic detail datum at nominal corner; x right and y up. Axes retained separately because the drawing supplies ordinate callouts, not an explicit paired point table.

profiles.coordinateConvention: Local top-left datum shown in detail M; x right and y up; negative y ordinates descend from the datum.
profiles.note: Unpaired ordinate callouts, not a closed polygon.

profiles.coordinateConvention: Local section datum at outer front-side edge; x inward and y negative through device thickness. Top and bottom edges supply different x samples.
profiles.note: These are axis callouts for two edge curves; do not zip x/y or treat them as a complete paired contour.

reviewScope: Display/body/camera plus named apertures, connector clearance, keepout cones, button/sensor dimensions and three local contour ordinate sets. Magnetic locations and remaining detail contours are still incomplete. Magnet-detail complete polarity table, L1-L20/BV3/CG coordinates, Hall-sensor/compass and six exclusion regions reviewed. All BV/O/OR/CG positions and polarity entries are normalized. Individual PM y locations remain partial; group reference coordinates are retained.

magnetDetail.coordinateConvention: Magnet detail front view: origin at center smart-connector pin, x right, y up. This origin differs from the body-centred display coordinate system.
